justifications.r1: Colorless big mana rocks (Thran Dynamo, Gilded Lotus, Urza lands, Forsaken Monument).
justifications.r2: Colorless draw artifacts (Mind Stone, Hedron Archive, Kozilek).
justifications.a1: Colorless tutors (Expedition Map, Conduit of Ruin).
justifications.a2: Reaches 10 mana for Ulamog on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents indestructible 10/10 with mill 20 on attack on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to eliminate players.
justifications.p3: Indestructible titan visible in command zone.
justifications.i1: Ulamog cast trigger exiles two permanents on cast.
justifications.i2: Attack trigger exiles top 20 cards of defending player's library.
justifications.s2: High mana base allows recasting even through commander tax.
justifications.s3: Other colorless titans act as independent threats.
